name: GenManip-Package-OOC_Bench
description: Benchmark from the GenManipSuite for out-of-context (OOC) evaluation of manipulation models: measures how well models generalize manipulation action or plan generation to unseen objects and environments. Tasks typically require mapping visual/state observations to action sequences or manipulation plans and assessing success on novel configurations.
evaluation_method: task_success_rate (evaluation of generated action sequences / plans)
reputation: Hosted on Hugging Face; niche adoption within manipulation-generalization research groups.
